The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] operated a '''safe house''' in the [[Sullust/Legends|Sullustan]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Fulluusub]]. Several of the safe house's operatives frequented the nearby [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] [[Need's Mead]], though their [[Officer/Legends|officers]] disapproved.<ref name="Strongholds" />
